run_preprocess_questions_pkl: run the CLI to preprocess EmbodiedQA questions and nav data into HDF5 train val test splits
tokenize_sequence: tokenize a string sequence into tokens with optional start end tokens and punctuation removal
build_vocab_from_sequences: build a token to index vocabulary from a list of text sequences with a minimum count threshold
encode_tokens_to_indices: encode a list of string tokens into integer indices using a token to index vocabulary
decode_indices_to_tokens: decode a list of integer indices back into string tokens using an index to token mapping
